title: Hydrogen adsorption in different carbon nanostructures
material_description: Activated carbon I | activated carbon from Canada (Table 1: 'Activated carbon I (Canada)'), synthesized by R. Chahine, Université du Quebec; described as similar to AX-21, which is obtained from the reaction of coke with KOH
activation_method: reaction of coke with KOH (as printed: 'similar to AX-21, which is obtained from the reaction of coke with KOH')
source_location: main-1 Abstract ('storage capacity of 4.5 wt% at 77 K'); main-4 p. 2212 Section 3 left column ('storage capacity of about 4.5 wt% at 77 K'); main-5 p. 2213 Section 4 ('store up to 4.5 wt%')
notes: Same value printed three times (abstract '4.5 wt%', Section 3 'about 4.5 wt%', conclusion 'up to 4.5 wt%'); one row, uptake_bound = approximate from 'about'. No pressure printed (pressure_unstated = true). The paper defines the 77 K 'storage capacity' as 'evaluated from the saturation value of the Langmuir fit' (Section 3, Fig. 3), so this is a saturation/maximum value; it is not merged with a Fig. 2a point because the paper does not say which point it was taken from and prints no pressure. value_kind = measured by rule: 4.5 lies within 3% of the digitized Fig. 2a 77 K point at 48.2 bar (4.621 wt%, archive: fig2a_activated_carbon_I_77K.json); otherwise it would be fitted_extrapolated. No isotherm_id because the paper does not say the value comes from the Fig. 2a curve. replicates_reported = true: error bars on the Fig. 2a 77 K isotherm of this sample and on its Fig. 3 point (no printed numerical uncertainty). BET SSA printed as 2560 m2/g in the abstract; Table 1 value 2564 stored. Table 1: BET SSA 2564 m2/g; average pore diameter printed 11.75 Å; pore volume (radius <6.5 Å) 0.75 cm3/g; helium density 2.0 g/cm3. synthesis_method coded chemical_activation from the AX-21/KOH sentence; the paper says only that the sample is 'similar to AX-21'. Basis not named in the paper (y axis 'weight % storage'); manually controlled Sieverts apparatus with blank (Seasand) correction and He-measured sample volume, so basis_inferred = excess by instrumental default. wt% convention not defined. Degassing printed: 'degassed and heated at 200 °C for approximately 2 h until a pressure of 1 × 10^-6 mbar' (stored 2 h, 1e-4 Pa). Sample mass printed only as 'typically 100–300 mg' (not stored); H2 printed as 'ultra pure' (no number). Sieverts apparatus described with a schematic (Fig. 1) but not stated to be home-built and no manufacturer/model, so instrument_identified = false. Pore volume = Table 1 'pore volume for pores with radius <6.5 Å' (diameter <1.3 nm), MP-method (extension of de Boer t-method) on N2 at 77 K; average pore diameter method not stated. BET: N2 at 77 K, 'multipoint BET method', relative-pressure range not stated. Helium density from Table 1 stored as skeletal density.
free_volume_calibration: blank run with a non-adsorbing blind sample (Seasand) of the same volume as the carbon sample; sample volume measured volumetrically with helium gas (He temperature not stated)
